newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine current account deficit up in Q3 '96.
newsitem.headline: Argentine current account deficit up in Q3 '96.

text.p: Argentina ran up a $918-million current account deficit in the third quarter of 1996, up from a $204-million deficit in the same period of 1995, the Economy Ministry said in a report Tuesday.
"The increase is mainly explained by the smaller trade surplus," the report said.
"The deficit was financed in equal parts with net capital inflows and the use of foreign reserves," it added.
The current account deficit in the first nine months of 1996 grew 94 percent from the same period the year before to $2.15 billion.
